blocking_methods.instructions: Log in to internet banking at https://online.gsc.bank.in/OnlineGSCB/login and use the card block/hotlist option.

Block via the bank's mobile app (Cards > Block/Hotlist). Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mbanking.gscbb.gscbb | iOS: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/gscb-mobile-banking/id1662847138

No 24x7 toll-free hotline, SMS block keyword or hotlist number is published anywhere on the bank's official site; the only published numbers are chargeable Ahmedabad Head Office lines 079-27459000 and 079-27459905, with no operating hours stated and no overseas/NRI line. The only documented lost-card channel is the Report Frauds web form, which asks the reporter to supply the ATM card number and linked account number and, for mobile-banking theft, the registered mobile number of the lost phone. Internet Banking (retail https://online.gsc.bank.in/OnlineGSCB/login, corporate https://online.gsc.bank.in/OnlineGSCB/corpLogin) and the official GSC Bank mobile-banking app are live channels, but the bank publishes no card-block menu path for either. The bank's Cyber Awareness page mentions the national Cyber Crime Helpline 1930 and cybercrime.gov.in.

The bank does not issue credit cards: the official site's product catalogue lists only the RuPay Platinum Debit Card and no credit-card product, page or blocking channel exists anywhere on the site (the only 'Debit / Credit Cards' wording is generic ATM acceptance of other banks' cards). The Head Office lines and the Report Frauds form listed under 'debit' are the only published contacts applicable in any card emergency. The old entry repeated the same unverified toll-free/netbanking claims for credit as for debit; both are now dropped.
